description: Format a plain-text trust breakdown and next-action remediation checklist for an Ed25519-signed paxiom.receipt.v0 API delivery receipt. Use this instead of verify_receipt when displaying a readable verdict to a user or operator; use verify_receipt when code needs raw check fields for programmatic gating, or get_x402_verifier_info to discover live Base USDC settlement endpoints. Runs deterministically offline for free with no auth: tampered, unauthorized, expired, or unconfirmed receipts return isError=false with an actionable diagnostic explanation rather than throwing, and omitting trustedVerifierPublicKeys trusts the host counter-attestation key by default. Pass output with the delivered HTTP response body to check SHA-256 payload binding (omitting output caps trustState at valid_signature_only).

expectedIssuerPublicKeys.description: Optional pinned base64 Ed25519 seller public keys (e.g. from /.well-known/x402-keys.json).

expectedPayTo.description: Optional expected seller payTo address from the 402 quote.

output.description: Optional delivered HTTP response payload; pass whenever available so SHA-256 payload binding is evaluated alongside the Ed25519 signature.

receipt.description: Parsed paxiom.receipt.v0 JSON envelope (decoded from Payment-Receipt or X-Paxiom-Receipt HTTP header).

trustedVerifierPublicKeys.description: Optional canonical base64 32-byte Ed25519 public keys trusted to assert settlement.checkedByVerifier=true (defaults to the host key).

name: explain_receipt

explanation.description: Multi-line human-readable trust breakdown, failed/skipped check details, and next-step remediation guidance.

receiptHash.description: Hex SHA-256 digest of the canonical signing input, or null when schema validation failed.

trustState.description: Underlying verification state explained in the report.

title: Format Human-Readable Receipt Explanation
